videos.overview:
It's Luca Benvenuto's first day as coordinator of the 10th Tuscolano. The case is an assault on a couple. Meanwhile, Marco, Elena Argenti's brother, the new inspector of the district, finds himself in trouble due to gambling debts with the boss Luciano Gerace.

Irene is taken to the hospital in very serious conditions and the entire district gathers around her and Alessandro. Meanwhile, Luca organizes the search for the robbers. Raffaele and Elena, instead, must investigate the death of a boy, Antonio Servidei, whose body was found on a construction site.

videos.title: Until the Last Breath / Impossible Love
videos.overview:
Little Simone Fioroni is kidnapped from his mother Matilde's car. Meanwhile Alessandro continues his investigations into the robbery gang; following the trail of the car used by the robbers, which had been rigged, he arrives at a mechanic who is a potential accomplice of the criminals; to make him confess he risks going over the limit and is stopped by Luca, with whom he ends up arguing.

Alberta Tizzani was attacked in her home and helped by her neighbor Marcello; it is he who suggests to the men of the X° Tuscolano that, although the woman claims it was a theft, the culprit could be Cristiano, her husband, a domineering and violent man. Cristiano, however, denies everything.

videos.title: The Spiral of Hate / The Last Call
videos.overview:
A woman accuses her ex-husband of beating and kidnapping her, but he denies it and for our men, faced with a web of hatred and lies, it becomes difficult to understand the truth. On the investigation side of the robbery gang, a glimmer of hope seems to open up: it seems that the gang will strike again soon. Our men prepare to surprise them on the spot.

After the disappointment of the failed operation to arrest the members of the robbery gang, a strange phone call takes our heroes to the scene of a murder. The victim is an acrobat thief who may have stepped on someone's toes. But by investigating the man's movements, another truth will emerge. Meanwhile, Alessandro, thanks to a case he stumbles upon, finally faces his grief and returns to Irene's grave.

videos.title: Abuse of Power / Box Number 37
videos.overview:
The men of the 10th Tuscolano are on the trail of the Talicam technician who passed the gang the codes needed to carry out the robberies. In the meantime, a murder is committed in a call center and suspicion falls on one of the employees.

After the setback caused by the death of Talicam technician Ottavio Rinaldi, the men of the X° Tuscolano manage to trace a clandestine gambling den run by Camorrista Luciano Gerace.

videos.title: Side Effects / The Last Journey
videos.overview:
While Luca follows the trail of Luciano Gerace's (Dante Palladino) Camorra clan, Alessandro, trusting his police instinct, decides to "hook up" Melissa. Meanwhile, the rest of the X° Tuscolano deals with the murder of a mother, in which the main suspect is the woman's stepson. The case is complicated by the fact that the only witness is the lady's biological son, an autistic boy with whom no one seems able to communicate.

While Luca perseveres on the trail of the Camorra, Alessandro continues to see Melissa in secret, putting his life at risk. The case of the episode instead concerns the alleged suicide of a woman no longer young suffering from cancer, whose "last journey" hides a much more disturbing truth.

videos.title: Invisibles / The Economy of Feelings
videos.overview:
After risking being killed, Alessandro involves his companions in the search for Melissa, which, in a crescendo of tension, ends with our friends falling into a trap set by the Flaviano brothers. During the episode, the murder of a construction site foreman is also investigated: what at first glance seems to be a simple case of revenge linked to accidental deaths at work, actually hides a much more complex scenario.

Having miraculously escaped the Flaviano attack, our heroes receive a tip from Melissa that leads to the discovery of the weapons used in the robbery in a warehouse in Gerace. The investigations therefore seem to be concluded, but Luca and his team still have doubts. Meanwhile, an investigation is being carried out into the murder of a pharmaceutical representative struggling with a financial hole in his company and two women, his current wife and his ex, who hate each other to death.

videos.title: A Stranger Among Us / Ghosts of the Past
videos.overview:
The men of the 10th Tuscolano are busy solving a case involving a young non-EU citizen. Thanks also to the help of Vittoria our men discover that Samira, the young woman, is the nanny of a family blackmailed by some loan sharks.

Anna and Raffaele deal with a case involving Alessia, raped a year earlier and now accused of taking revenge on the culprit.

videos.title: The Nameless Arcanum / Guilty of Innocence
videos.overview:
Melissa's death triggers a deep crisis in the District. Especially in Alessandro, who feels responsible. After solving a mysterious murder case in which a fortune teller was the victim, however, news arrives that Melissa did not commit suicide: perhaps there is a clue to start again.

While Giulio Flaviano suffers from withdrawal, our heroes discover that the morphine used by Irene's killers is purchased thanks to a stolen prescription pad, therefore recognizable: they just have to wait for them to go back to do the "shopping". In the meantime, they have to solve the case of a girl who disappeared 12 years earlier and was found in a coma in a wood.

videos.title: The Law of Love / Listening
videos.overview:
The inspectors of the 10th Tuscolano are dealing with a case involving a Muslim girl, Khadigia, beaten and repudiated by her husband Yusuf. Khadigia claims to have never been with a man and it will be up to Anna and Elena to understand what lies behind this mystery. In the meantime, Luca and Alessandro, who narrowly missed capturing Giulio Flaviano, are now convinced: there is a mole who informs the criminals of their every move.

The death of a twenty-year-old involves our team in a case with no apparent solution. Suspicions focus on the two roommates. Anna's brilliant intuition will reveal a much more bitter truth.

videos.title: Blind Date / Out of Order
videos.overview:
Alessandro drops by Elena's house. Alessandro discovers who really killed Irene... Marco, meanwhile, runs away. Luca has to take care of Nick, who has returned to Rome to see a friend of his and ends up entangled in a nasty story of drug trafficking.

The body of a taxi driver is found in a prostitution area. The investigation soon turns to the homosexual circuit. The revelation shocks the man's children, who did not know their father's true nature. Meanwhile, the Flavianos kidnap a woman. And to save her, Marco puts his own life at risk.

videos.title: Until Proven Guilty / Sisters
videos.overview:
Her brother Marco is dead, but Elena can't forgive him for Irene's murder. And while the Flavianos are quietly enjoying the wait to complete the deal with Krueger, our heroes must solve the case of a surgeon accused of uxoricide, who loses his mind and takes Ingargiola and Elena hostage.

From a clue left by the Flavianos in their suite, Luca and his men finally manage to understand the ultimate goal of their plan: to get their hands on an illegal load of coltan, a precious mineral compound.

videos.title: The Thief of Lives / The Thursday Lady
videos.overview:
Thanks to Berti's incursion on Krueger's boat, our guys intercept the agreements between Gerace and the Flavianos, to intervene during the meeting between the boss and the Roman brothers. But first they have to face and solve a case that is close to everyone's heart: the former colleague Parmesan is accused of the murder of a loan shark.

Our team investigates the death of a woman. What appears to be an accident during sexual intercourse, takes on the appearance of a voluntary homicide, of which the woman's lover is suspected.

videos.title: Couples' Game / You Die Twice
videos.overview:
While the men of the X° Tuscolano prepare to celebrate Anna's wedding, they must solve a stalking case involving a young teacher. Meanwhile, a body that seems to be Valerio Flaviano is found in Perugia.

The film based on Ugo's book is ready. All of our people attend the preview except Elena, who disappeared without giving any explanation. Her colleagues are convinced that she was kidnapped.

videos.title: Prey (Part One) / Prey (Part Two)
videos.overview:
The presence at the 10th Tuscolano Police District of the only witness to a brutal murder committed on the edge of a wood is the cause of an unexpected and tragic ambush by two killers who, in an attempt to kill the witness, fatally shoot Carlo, Inspector Gori's ex-boyfriend, and wound Officer Raffaele Marchetti.

The investigation into the murder that took place in the woods leads the inspectors of the 10th Tuscolano to discover that the murderers are a group of expert hunters from the area, who met in Kenya during a hunting safari.

videos.title: Like a Son / The Black Priest
videos.overview:
The mystery of Carlo's murder and her confusing and frustrating love affair with Commissioner Luca Benvenuto push Inspector Anna Gori to throw herself headlong into the search for a mysterious Russian woman linked to Carlo for reasons still unknown. The investigation leads her to a Russian restaurant where she meets Dorian, a charming and gallant Hungarian who, struck by her beauty, invites her to meet again. Anna, under a false identity, accepts the invitation.

While inspectors Lorenzo and Elena are dealing with the case of attempted poisoning of a black priest that occurred during mass in a parish in Tuscolano, inspector Anna Gori, frustrated by her relationship with Luca, continues to investigate Katarina Leventaggi, discovering that Carlo had given her emergency medical assistance.

videos.title: Double Lives / Island
videos.overview:
The inspectors of the 10th Tuscolano investigate the kidnapping of the fifteen-year-old daughter of a Romanian bookseller who hides a past as a policeman under the Ceausescu regime. Meanwhile, the investigations into Carlo's murder and the mysterious Russian woman he was in contact with lead Inspector Anna Gori and Commissioner Luca Benvenuto to the discovery of his possible involvement in drug trafficking.

The investigations of the inspectors of the X° Tuscolano, assisted by the young inspector Gabriele Mancini, focus on the murder of a young aspiring cartoonist found dead in a ditch in the hamlet of Tor Pagnotta. The evidence seems to demonstrate the guilt of the caretaker of an exclusive residence in the area in whose swimming pool the young man used to clandestinely dive, but the investigations will reveal unsuspected background.

videos.title: In His Place / It's Already Tomorrow
videos.overview:
The investigation into the murder of a young lawyer from a well-known law firm leads the District inspectors to discover a fatal case of mistaken identity, but the many truths that emerge from the investigation will bring to light the firm's secret dirty dealings.

The inspectors of the 10th Tuscolano investigate the origin of the bruises found on the bodies of three children, guilty of a small theft in a toy store. The case becomes complicated when the main suspect, the parish priest of the neighborhood, is found dead in his home.

videos.title: When It Gets Evening (Part One) / When It Gets Evening (Part Two)
videos.overview:
The investigation of the new inspector Gabriele Mancini into a series of rapes of young women who were former drug addicts that took place in the Parco degli Acquedotti takes an unexpected turn when he himself is recognized by one of the victims as the culprit. Contrary to the orders of the magistrate Castelli, inspector Anna Gori continues her operation of infiltration into the Russian mafia environment.

The rape accusations leveled against Inspector Mancini by one of the victims of the Parco degli Acquedotti seem to be supported by the discovery that the mother in her youth had been hospitalized in a Swiss clinic for drug addiction. Subjected to a psychiatric evaluation, the inspector will prove to be completely innocent and, rehabilitated in the investigation, will be able to identify the real culprit.

videos.title: An Unspeakable Love / Look at Me
videos.overview:
An elderly German is found hanged in a B&B room and the inspectors of the X Tuscolanoo start an investigation challenging the hypothesis of an apparent suicide. The revelation of his youthful membership in the German army will lead them to the discovery of ancient partisan grudges that have never been quelled.

The District inspectors are engaged in the case of the kidnapping of an eighteen-year-old girl, who according to her father's testimony would have staged a false kidnapping to obtain money from him. The hypothesis is denied by the discovery that the girl is dead and her body lies inside the trunk of the car in the open countryside.

videos.title: What Remains of the Fathers / Sleight of Hand
videos.overview:
The kidnapping of a company official by workers in protest against job cuts turns into a tragedy when an elderly worker is found dead. The investigations of the X inspectors will try to shed light on a possible murder case. The investigation into the Italian financial company, an economic mediator for the Russian mafia, yields unexpected results.

Officially transferred to a Swiss clinic for a leg operation, Inspector Anna Gori resumes in absolute secrecy her mission of infiltration in the Russian mafia environment where Pavel's change at the top of the organization makes her relationship with Dorian more risky.

videos.title: Rained from the Sky / Tests of Courage
videos.overview:
The District inspectors are dealing with the disappearance of a young pony express who "ruinously" came into possession of a bag full of cash. The case turns dark when his body is found in the ravine of a park.

While her colleagues from the 10th Tuscolano investigate the robbery of an armored van and discover that the driver's death was a case of premeditated murder, Inspector Anna Gori has to deal with Nadja's suspicions, whose distrust of her risks infecting Dorian as well.

videos.title: Frequencies / Money and Women
videos.overview:
The desperate radio appeals of a kidnapped girl are intercepted by a teenage radio amateur but it will be up to the District inspectors to identify the place where she is being held captive and free her in time for an urgent surgical operation. Inspector Anna Gori must regain the trust of Dorian who, knowing that she is aware of his membership in the criminal organization, fears she may report him to the police.

A wealthy forty-year-old owner of a temporary employment agency is killed by a prostitute in an apartment rented by the hour. It will be up to the inspectors to prove the woman's innocence and identify the real culprit. Inspector Anna Gori has shown Dorian that he can trust her, but that is not enough to save her life.

videos.title: In the Dark / A New Life
videos.overview:
A mysterious killer kills a young woman staying at an institute for the blind. The suspicions of the inspectors of the X Tuscolano focus on the director and owner of the institute, the only beneficiary of the insurance policy taken out by the woman before her death, but the testimony of a friend of the victim who smelled the killer will lead the investigators on the right track.

Contrary to Commissioner Benvenuti's orders, Inspector Anna Gori thwarts the raid on the Russian mafia's weapons depot and saves Dorian. Having gained his trust, she manages to attend the meeting of the organization's leaders and photograph them, but realizes she is being spied on.

videos.title: Neighborhood War / A Different Future
videos.overview:
The investigators of the 10th Tuscolano are investigating the beating death of a young man who was robbed in the street, but the evidence regarding the guilt of a Romanian from the neighborhood does not convince Commissioner Benvenuto, who will have to challenge the xenophobic feelings of the people in the neighborhood to bring the real culprit to justice.

The investigations of the inspectors of the X Tuscolano focus on a triple homicide: a wealthy elderly couple and a robber found murdered in the couple's villa. The case becomes complicated when the main suspect, the couple's youngest son, is found murdered.

videos.overview:
Abandoned unconscious by Dorian in the beach house in Ostia, Inspector Gori is rescued by her colleagues. Upon awakening from a concussion, the woman discovers on her body a mysterious tattoo given to her by Dorian. While the inspectors are looking for the lighter with the mole's prints lost by Gori on the beach in Ostia, Commissioner Benvenuti becomes convinced that the mole is the magistrate Castelli.

The analysis of the Russian mole's footprints exonerates the magistrate Castelli and reveals the true identity of the secret informant: Katarina Kasparova, the girl long sought by Inspector Gori and then believed to be dead. The magistrate recognizes her as his governess from the East, Maria, and thanks to her testimony the inspectors of the X will be able to find Dorian's traces.

videos.title: Gioco di prestigio
videos.overview: Officially transferred to a Swiss clinic for a leg operation, Inspector Anna Gori resumes in absolute secrecy her mission of infiltration in the Russian mafia environment where Pavel's change at the top of the organization makes her relationship with Dorian more risky.

videos.title: Piovuti dal cielo
videos.overview: The District inspectors are dealing with the disappearance of a young pony express who "ruinously" came into possession of a bag full of cash. The case turns dark when his body is found in the ravine of a park.

videos.title: Prove di coraggio
videos.overview: While her colleagues from the 10th Tuscolano investigate the robbery of an armored van and discover that the driver's death was a case of premeditated murder, Inspector Anna Gori has to deal with Nadja's suspicions, whose distrust of her risks infecting Dorian as well.

videos.title: Frequenze
videos.overview: The desperate radio appeals of a kidnapped girl are intercepted by a teenage radio amateur but it will be up to the District inspectors to identify the place where she is being held captive and free her in time for an urgent surgical operation. Inspector Anna Gori must regain the trust of Dorian who, knowing that she is aware of his membership in the criminal organization, fears she may report him to the police.

videos.title: I soldi e le donne
videos.overview: A wealthy forty-year-old owner of a temporary employment agency is killed by a prostitute in an apartment rented by the hour. It will be up to the inspectors to prove the woman's innocence and identify the real culprit. Inspector Anna Gori has shown Dorian that he can trust her, but that is not enough to save her life.

videos.title: Al buio
videos.overview: A mysterious killer kills a young woman staying at an institute for the blind. The suspicions of the inspectors of the X Tuscolano focus on the director and owner of the institute, the only beneficiary of the insurance policy taken out by the woman before her death, but the testimony of a friend of the victim who smelled the killer will lead the investigators on the right track.

videos.title: Una nuova vita
videos.overview: Contrary to Commissioner Benvenuti's orders, Inspector Anna Gori thwarts the raid on the Russian mafia's weapons depot and saves Dorian. Having gained his trust, she manages to attend the meeting of the organization's leaders and photograph them, but realizes she is being spied on.

videos.overview:
Palermo. Deputy Commissioner Giulia Corsi has an appointment with Alfio Spada, a member of the Serao clan who is showing signs of repentance. During the meeting, Spada begins to reveal something hot but two hitmen burst in and open fire. Giulia, wounded, is unable to save her informant. Meanwhile, in Rome, many colleagues have left the X Tuscolano. Understaffed, our men wonder why replacements haven't arrived yet.

Luca meets Viola and informs her of the tragedy that occurred, showing himself to be very close to his dear childhood friend. While the search for the bodies at the site of the explosion continues, Luca must still solve a complex case. Journalist Cosimo Notari has fallen victim to a clear mafia execution.

videos.title: Memories and Lies / A Better Future
videos.overview:
Luca is saved thanks to the bulletproof vest he was wearing. Giulia tells him that their investigation also leads to Paolo's true killer, while it turns out that Remo is still alive. The 10th Tuscolano will no longer be closed, and meanwhile, the third new recruit, Pietro, arrives, who, along with Gabriele and Marta, investigates the murder of a car dealership owner.

A trap for the men of the X, who find themselves in the middle of a sea of ​​bullets. Giulia Corsi forced to deal with the death of Luisa Baccarini, her only possible witness. The case of a missing child and a man, Remo Damiani, who reappears before Viola's eyes, forcing her to make a heartbreaking choice.

videos.title: Masks and Faces / It Was My Mother
videos.overview:
Convinced that Luisa Baccarini was murdered, our men investigate the few traces of DNA found at the crime scene. The lead turns out to be good. Thus begins the hunt for Oscar Romero. But Viola also wants to get in touch with Remo, who she has discovered is alive. Meanwhile, X is busy solving the case of an elderly retired teacher found murdered in a park.

Investigating the murder of a famous TV presenter, our heroes come into contact for the first time with a world of appearances and unbridled ambitions, which push even ordinary people to exploit their feelings to indulge their desire for money and success. Meanwhile, Remo's gang continues to evade capture... and Giulia and Luca come into conflict over this.

videos.title: Ghosts / Proof of Love
videos.overview:
Who put that bouquet of flowers on Paolo Libero's grave? Giulia is determined to find out. But Luca also has his own ghost to chase, because the clues that lead him to think that Remo is still alive are starting to become too many. Meanwhile, the search for a missing eighteen-year-old tells us once again that the world of teenagers can hide many secrets.

The discovery of a man's body uncovers an intricate and ferocious family story in which it will be difficult for our heroes to figure out who the real culprit of the murder is. In the meantime, the investigations into Remo Damiani's gang continue apace. And in one long night, the fates of the men of the X, their loved ones, and their sworn enemies will be decided.

videos.title: Tsunami / Causes and Effects
videos.overview:
Giulia Corsi hostage of Oscar Romero. These are dramatic hours for her, for her and for Barbara Rostagno who finds herself hunting the man who killed her sister... Meanwhile, the case of a broken family, the Ricciardis, torn apart by the sudden return of a 'ghost', erupts at X like a tsunami.

The man who killed Paolo Libero doesn't have a name yet, but Giulia Corsi has never been so close to him. Just like Luca, who has never been so close to Remo and meets him again in a tragic and violent circumstance. Meanwhile, the case of a dead researcher will shed light on new scams and old gossip in the academic world.

videos.title: Far from Here / Feelings of Guilt
videos.overview:
Viola's conditions, after the attack, seem stable and Luca can breathe a sigh of relief, but when he goes to visit her, she reveals to him that she has been playing a double game with Remo, right from the start. Meanwhile, Giulia is on the trail of a mysterious lawyer. Could he be the puppeteer behind this whole story?

Giulia decides that the time has come to lure Remo into a trap using Viola as bait, but Luca does not agree. Meanwhile, the research on the mysterious lawyer finally bears fruit.

videos.title: The Third Eye / Hanging by a Thread
videos.overview:
Thanks to Luca's help, Viola manages to obtain house arrest. A painful meeting between the two will clarify the woman's true feelings. Giulia, meanwhile, continues to investigate Balsamo, against all odds.

Giulia is forced by an unforeseen event to leave for Palermo, but the investigations on Balsamo and his role, the link between mafia and politics, resume. And while Corsi investigates in the Sicilian capital, in Rome a serious threat looms over an honest and incorruptible councilor.

videos.title: At the Last Second / The Wolf's Lair
videos.overview:
Luca and his colleagues from the X Tuscolano await Giulia's return from Palermo. But they are not the only ones: on the orders of the lawyer Balsamo, Remo and Diego are ready to blow her up with a car bomb. What Remo does not know is that the lawyer has decided that he too must die in the attack.

After the order to abandon the investigation on Balsamo, Giulia decides to continue investigating on her own. She begins to secretly monitor the lawyer's villa, who, however, is already preparing his countermove.

videos.title: A Dangerous Suspect / A Sad Laugh
videos.overview:
The meeting between Giulia and Balsamo has dramatic and unpredictable results. What if Corsi's obsession with the lawyer had led her to truly lose her mind? In the meantime, Barbara finds herself entangled in a case that brings her entire past into play.

Giulia is in prison, but Luca continues to deal with the investigation, perhaps he has found a small crack in the accusatory system. In the meantime, Barbara is kidnapped by the mysterious serial killer. Pietro and Gabriele manage to save her, but a sensational twist completely overturns the direction of the investigation.

videos.title: Unusual Suspects / The Walking Dead
videos.overview:
After the discovery of Andrea Greco's body, suspicions about who the serial killer might be focus on Roberto, Barbara's ex-husband. Rostagno is initially incredulous, but little by little she realizes that the hypothesis is far from unfounded.

Luca is convinced that Remo's testimony can finally exonerate Giulia, but it is still too early to claim victory. Viola is still in Balsamo's hands and Remo is willing to risk his life to save her.

videos.title: Life at Stake / Another Chance
videos.overview:
The day of reckoning has come for Remo, Luca, Diego and Ettore. The stakes are high and twofold: on one side, the life of Viola Damiani; on the other, the freedom of Giulia Corsi. But in the meantime, there is no time to waste, the Tenth must solve the case of Simonetta Cerci, a young mother murdered in a barbaric way.

A new pain for Luca Benvenuto. Enzo Tiberi, the man who many years before, thanks to boxing, saved him from taking the bad path of crime, has been killed, stabbed. Luca does everything he can to solve the case. But he must also deal with the testimony of Ettore, Balsamo's Mephistophelian right-hand man, and the definitive release of Giulia Corsi.

videos.title: Secret Lives / The Weaker Sex
videos.overview:
Balsamo has escaped. But where? The police all over Italy are alerted. The justice system is about to tighten around the shady lawyer, the instigator of Paolo Libero's death. But the daily life of the Tenth is also calling: the case of what appears to be a double, mysterious murder must be solved.

Denise, a femme fatale desired by all. And that all the men she frequented, jealous of her, could have killed. And in the meantime, the frantic race to find Balsamo before he escapes again, and this time it is no longer possible to understand where. Keeping everything under control, for Luca and Giulia, is increasingly difficult, especially if the boss Carmine Serao also enters the scene.

videos.title: Before It Happens / Little Girl's Games
videos.overview:
After the death of Remo, brutally murdered by the Serao, Luca promises little Marco to avenge his father's death. But to do this he needs the lawyer Balsamoche who proposes to the police a pact that is hard to accept, especially for Giulia. In the meantime, the ordinary investigations focus on the mysterious disappearance of a screenwriter.

Giulia is still struggling with the bomb to defuse. Balsamo is risking his life. The Serao clan must be stopped at all costs. A bitter ending for Giulia, too bitter and in fact together with Luca she decides to reopen the game. It's not over yet, it can't end until Paolo Libero has obtained justice.

videos.overview:
Luca Benvenuto has obtained a promotion that will take him far from the X Tuscolano. To direct the District in his place comes Leonardo Brandi, a former infiltrator of the Flying Squad who has just concluded an anti-money laundering operation in Germany. The two will work side by side for a few days, hunting down the dangerous escapee Rocco Liverani.

Leo, Luca and the rest of the X Tuscolano continue to hunt Rocco Liverani. For some reason the man does not seem to want to leave Rome, for now. It is as if he has a plan, but what is it? Following his intuition, Luca tries to break a trail on his own, but a surprise awaits him.

videos.title: Split in two (part one) / Split in two (part two)
videos.overview:
Even though Luca is wounded, he does not give up and faces Corallo in a desperate hand-to-hand fight. His colleagues at the District, not seeing him arrive, are increasingly apprehensive, but in the meantime they have to deal with the dramatic kidnapping of a child.

While investigating Luca's death, Leo and the men of the X Tuscolano come into conflict with some agents of the Flying Squad. Gallo intervenes to calm the waters and reestablish the respective boundaries of competence, but Leo decides to get around the obstacle in his own way.

videos.title: Giarabub / Pirates
videos.overview:
Before the Mobile can stop him, Leo manages to talk to Pulcino and trace the name of the person who stole Luca's cell phone. The investigation focuses on the world of prostitution and leads again to the name of Ekaterina Ratnikova. Only that the girl, at this point, has disappeared.

After the search of Ekaterina's house, the men of the X Tuscolano discover that the relationship between Guarinelli and his informant is much more than a simple professional bond. Now all they have to do is tail the policeman and wait for him to give himself away, but the task turns out to be more difficult than expected.

videos.title: The clone factory / The strength of a love
videos.overview:
The meeting with Ekaterina has borne fruit and the men of the X Tuscolano finally have a name to investigate: Mara Fermi, the escort Luca was tailing the night he was killed. But the lead is thin and the girl has no criminal record, and Leo decides that the best way to get the information they need from her is for someone to become her confidant.

While Corallo continues to prepare his escape, Leo intensifies his research on the sports club attended by Mara. In the meantime, his relationship with Valentina becomes more and more passionate, but a nasty surprise awaits him.

videos.title: Love for sale / Jackals
videos.overview:
After discovering that Valentina is an escort, Leo decides to take his time before telling his men. But Barbara and Pietro have secretly looked at the transcripts of Zurletti's interrogation and now suspect that Leo wants to cover up his woman.

Leo wants to get a search warrant for the sports club Valentina frequents, but Gallo stops him. More evidence needs to be gathered first.

videos.title: Clandestine games / The trap
videos.overview:
After discovering that Corallo has arrived from Germany with one hundred million euros, Mara tries to seduce him. But Corallo, still closed in grief over the death of his son, reacts coldly to her approach. The initiative then passes to Valentina.

Valentina has managed to overcome Corallo's reluctance and become familiar with him, but it may be too late. The fugitive's boat is in fact ready and the man seems intent on setting sail as soon as possible.

videos.title: Lost / A fatal talent
videos.overview:
Mara and Valentina are sure that the money is hidden somewhere on Corallo's boat, but they don't know where. Valentina then decides to ask Cayard for help, who knows a thing or two about boats. In the meantime, Leo looks for Valentina at the sports club, just as Corallo is about to leave.

After seeing Leo at the sports club, Corallo postpones her departure to get revenge. And to do so, she decides to use Valentina.

videos.title: Luca's blood / The bad road
videos.overview:
The plan worked and Corallo finally has Leo under his gun. The men of the X Tuscolano attempt a desperate race against time to foil the attack, but this time the balance of fortune seems to tip in Corallo's favor.

Luca's murderer officially has a face, that of Antonio Corallo. And for the men of the X Tuscolano, finally, the hunt begins.

videos.title: The champion
videos.overview: After Cayard's death, Valentina and Mara immediately rush to the shipyard but, to their bitter surprise, they realize that Corallo's boat is no longer there.

videos.title: Chiara's memory
videos.overview: Leo and Gallo have alerted all the Mediterranean harbor authorities, but there is no trace of Corallo's boat. Leo then decides to start over, questioning Mara Fermi.

videos.title: Choices
videos.overview: The investigation into the escort ring inside the sports club has reached a dead end and, when all is said and done, Leo and his men realize that they do not have enough evidence to charge Martini with the exploitation of prostitution. This means that they have nothing in hand to put pressure on the manager of the club, so that he reveals information useful for the capture of Corallo. Pietro and Barbara then decide to follow another lead: that of the money with which the club was originally financed. Corallo, meanwhile, is fighting for survival in the mountains. With great difficulty he managed to extricate himself from the wild boar trap, but he has lost a lot of blood and the wound in his side risks becoming infected.

videos.title: A single mistake
videos.overview: Leo and his men finally have Corallo's false name, Franco Isoardi, from which they manage to trace the small hotel where Corallo stayed for a night before disappearing again into thin air. Leo and Pietro go there to question the owner of the hotel, who, in front of the photo of the fugitive, confirms that it is him, Franco Isoardi. But he doesn't have much else to add. Corallo paid in cash and didn't mention where he was headed. But in the lobby there is an internet station that the hotel makes available to guests and our men decide to check its history. Among the pages consulted during Corallo's stay there is one that reports the timetables of buses headed to the province of Rieti. That Corallo decided to spend his time on the run there seems unlikely but Leo decides to check anyway.

videos.title: Unpunishable / Homemade
videos.overview:
The hunt is on again. Leo and Gallo surround the woods where Corallo is hiding and organize the patrol batteries. With them is Brenta who, as a good Bergamasco, is perfectly at ease among the woods and slopes. Not only that, but he immediately dispenses a series of practical advice for tackling the mission, to the point that Leo decides to leave him permanently with the contingent of the Mobile.

Led by Brenta, the contingents of the Mobile and the X Tuscolano continue to hunt Corallo. Barbara and Pietro are exhausted, they feel like they are going round in circles, but Brenta reassures them: little by little they are pushing Corallo towards the edge of the woods, and sooner or later the man will be forced to make a misstep. And to prove his point he shows them a tree, whose branches appear to have been recently cut.

videos.title: Prejudice and good people / The wrong son
videos.overview:
The men of the Mobile and the X Tuscolano have surrounded the entire wooded area and are closing in on Corallo, who understands that he must move quickly if he doesn't want to be crushed. With him is Gualtieri, the hunter to whom he fed his dog. Corallo decides that the only way to escape the roadblocks is to use him as bait. He therefore orders him to call his wife on her cell phone so that she can join him in the car with his brother-in-law, pretending to be out on a Sunday outing.

After his daring escape from the woods, Corallo has managed to disappear. The X Tuscolano is in close contact with Interpol, but the news that is arriving is not comforting. The ferry on which they thought the fugitive had boarded, in fact, has been searched from top to bottom, but in vain. The question now is whether Corallo managed to disembark by eluding the controls, or whether he never boarded that ferry. In short, whether he has put into action yet another bluff.

videos.title: The dough and the police (part one) / The dough and the police (part two)
videos.overview:
After speaking with Liverani, Leo is increasingly convinced that Corallo has remained in Rome. Yes, but where is he hiding? Since they raided the sports club, it is clear that the man no longer has any support in the capital. And he probably wouldn't even look for it, Leo reflects. Corallo is basically like Liverani: a lone wolf, someone who doesn't trust, who prefers to remain invisible. And who are the truly invisible people in the city?

Corallo's plan is ready to enter its final phase. After putting on his diving suit, the man dives into the dock and recovers the suitcase full of cash that he had hidden in the bulb of the boat. Then he contacts Mara again: he must convince Valentina to return to his side to take the money. Mara doesn't understand: she is sure that if he tells Valentina, she will immediately tell Leo. But, at least on the surface, that is exactly what Corallo wants: to use Valentina as bait to lure Leo into a trap.

Guns in hand, the police advance, but when they reach him, the refuge is empty. They missed him by a hair's breadth: the remains of food buried nearby are still warm. In Rome, the men of the District are dealing with a case of arson against a pub.

videos.title: Pregiudizi e brave persone
videos.overview: The men of the Mobile and the X Tuscolano have surrounded the entire wooded area and are closing in on Corallo, who understands that he must move quickly if he doesn't want to be crushed. With him is Gualtieri, the hunter to whom he fed his dog. Corallo decides that the only way to escape the roadblocks is to use him as bait. He therefore orders him to call his wife on her cell phone so that she can join him in the car with his brother-in-law, pretending to be out on a Sunday outing. The plan is simple: once the police have let them pass, Corallo will take his brother-in-law's place in the car, while Gualtieri himself, with Corallo's backpack on his shoulder, will attract the police to himself. While Corallo is putting his plan together, the District investigates a strange series of apartment robberies.

videos.title: Il figlio sbagliato
videos.overview: After his daring escape from the woods, Corallo has managed to disappear. The X Tuscolano is in close contact with Interpol, but the news that is arriving is not comforting. The ferry on which they thought the fugitive had boarded, in fact, has been searched from top to bottom, but in vain. The question now is whether Corallo managed to disembark by eluding the controls, or whether he never boarded that ferry. In short, whether he has put into action yet another bluff. Leo decides to go to prison to ask Liverani for advice, who leans towards the second hypothesis. After all, it is the same trick that he had adopted: pretending to leave Rome and then acting undisturbed. And in fact, things are exactly like this: returning home, one evening, Mara finds an unexpected guest waiting for her, Antonio Corallo. But after the initial fright, the girl understands that the man does not want to hurt her.

videos.title: Il grano e la pula - 1a parte
videos.overview: After speaking with Liverani, Leo is increasingly convinced that Corallo has remained in Rome. Yes, but where is he hiding? Since they raided the sports club, it is clear that the man no longer has any support in the capital. And he probably wouldn't even look for it, Leo reflects. Corallo is basically like Liverani: a lone wolf, someone who doesn't trust, who prefers to remain invisible. And who are the truly invisible people in the city? Those without a cell phone or computer... Those who don't use credit cards and have no bank, no salary, no rent... No bills, no receipts, no Tom Thumb crumbs that can lead to him. Leo is now almost certain: Corallo has camouflaged himself among the homeless.

videos.title: Il grano e la pula - 2a parte
videos.overview: Corallo's plan is ready to enter its final phase. After putting on his diving suit, the man dives into the dock and recovers the suitcase full of cash that he had hidden in the bulb of the boat. Then he contacts Mara again: he must convince Valentina to return to his side to take the money. Mara doesn't understand: she is sure that if he tells Valentina, she will immediately tell Leo. But, at least on the surface, that is exactly what Corallo wants: to use Valentina as bait to lure Leo into a trap. In the meantime, the District manages to foil at the last moment the sophisticated robbery set up by a gang of university researchers in the previous episode. The plan had something of a genius about it: micronize a large quantity of gold and hide it among a load of toxic waste ready to be transferred to Germany.
